description.value: A vehicle-accessible forested campground at the east end of Juan de Fuca Provincial Park, serving as a trailhead for the rugged 47 km Juan de Fuca Marine Trail and a short drive from the tide-pool-rich Botanical Beach; the exposed Pacific surf coast is wild rather than gentle, and a seasonal gate limits access to summer.
